description: Delete only the explicitly supplied local-ydb host paths or Docker volumes. Use after inspecting local_ydb_storage_leftovers; without confirm=true this returns the cleanup plan and removes nothing.

configPath.description: Absolute path to an explicit local-ydb config file. Missing, unreadable, oversized, or invalid explicit files fail closed instead of using defaults.

confirm.description: Must be true to remove the explicitly supplied storage paths or Docker volumes. Omit or false for plan-only output.

paths.description: Explicit host filesystem paths to remove. Nothing is deleted unless each path is supplied here and confirm=true.

profile.description: Named profile from local-ydb.config.json. Defaults to config.defaultProfile.

volumes.description: Explicit Docker volume names to remove. Nothing is deleted unless each volume is supplied here and confirm=true.

name: local_ydb_cleanup_storage
